messages:
Evan (Partnerships): LuminaCompute sent their marketing bundle for marketplace + SI docs. Quick review requested: logo variants, lockup spacing, case quote reuse, and localization strings.
Tom (Partner Ops): Files here: https://drive.redwood/partners/luminacompute/marketplace_0626. Contains: lumina_mark.zip, lumina_case_study.pdf, lumina_locales.xlsx, lumina_brand_guide.pdf
Maya (Design): Opening guide  main note: their primary mark uses thin strokes which drop out at small sizes. Need a stroked-outline fallback or a thicker monoline version for 24px icons. Also they supplied a hero badge with outer glow  marketplace prohibits glows.
Ravi (PMM): For marketplace copy they proposed: "LuminaCompute + Redwood 1 latency at scale"  that's a claim. We should avoid numeric claims unless substantiated. Suggest: "LuminaCompute + Redwood: low-latency inference for production."
Tom (Partner Ops): Lumina included translations for en/es/fr in lumina_locales.xlsx. They want us to publish those as-is. We should pass them through localization QA.
Maya (Design): I'll create `lumina_badge_thick.svg` and `lumina_badge_mono.png` plus alt text file. Will add `lumina_readme_usage.md` with do/don't and responsive size guidance. ETA 3h.
Helga (Legal): On the case study: the quote references BetaCo and a demo log. I need the signed release. Tom, do we have a signed consent file?
Tom (Partner Ops): They uploaded `beta_release_signed_2026.pdf` in the same folder at 08:04.
Helga (Legal): I'll review. If the release only covers web case studies we might need an addendum for third-party marketplaces. Will update by EOD.
Ravi (PMM): For the co-authorship line, propose two options: 1) One-line: "In collaboration with LuminaCompute" 2) Two-line (for dedicated listings): "Powered by LuminaCompute
Optimized with Redwood Inference". Thoughts?
Evan (Partnerships): Both look good. Keep wording factual and non-promotional. Include a field in the README for partner-localized blurbs.
Maya (Design): Added `lumina_alt_text_en.md` with canonical alt text and localization instructions. Also uploaded `lumina_thumbnail_16x9_v1.jpg` mock to Figma link: https://figma.redwood/lumina-thumb-v1
PublishBot: Added checklist: assets-uploaded -> verify-legal -> localization-qa -> publish-ready. Assigned to @Tom and @Helga.
Tom (Partner Ops): I'll confirm localization QA and ping Lumina for any contested translations. Also will ask Solutions Eng if we can display "SI integration" lock next to the logos; if not yet verified, we will use the text "Integration partner".
Helga (Legal): Quick update: Beta release explicitly includes "third-party marketplaces" and permits quote reuse with attribution. Legal OK. Please keep the attribution line exactly as: "— BetaCo" when reusing.
Ravi (PMM): Great. I'll adjust copy to remove numeric claims and upload final marketplace copy as `partner-lumina-copy_v1.txt`.
Evan (Partnerships): Final checklist before publish: 1) thicker badge + mono variant (Maya) 2) alt text + locale placeholder (Maya/Tom) 3) legal clause added to README (Helga) 4) final copy file uploaded (Ravi) 5) Solutions Eng confirm SI badge (Evan to ping). Once all green, schedule marketplace publish.
Maya (Design): Exports done and uploaded with naming convention.
Tom (Partner Ops): Localization QA started. Lumina responded: they will send pt-BR translations by EOD.
Evan (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll follow up with Solutions Eng and update thread when we have final badge permission. :thumbsup:
